items.headline: Take a 360-degree look at college football's iconic rivalry trophies
items.description: Whether ancient, animal or absurd, college football's rivalry trophies take many shapes.

items.headline: Utah State visits Oregon State in Pac-12 matchup

items.headline: Sizing up college football's best races down the homestretch
items.description: From spots in the CFP and SEC title game to the hunt for bowl eligibility, there's still a lot on the line.

items.headline: Patience starting to run thin for head coaches in Week 11
items.description: Saturday didn't offer much to change the season's complexion, but some coaches are coming under pressure.

items.headline: No. 24 Boise State outlasts Oregon State, to host Pac-12 title game
items.description: Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and 3 TDs to help No. 24 Boise State outlast Oregon State 46-41 and wrap up the host spot in the Pac-12 title game.

items.headline: No. 17 Boise State outlasts Oregon State 46-41 to wrap up host spot in Pac-12 title game
items.description: — Rasean Jones caught 11 passes for 230 yards and three touchdowns to help No. 17 Boise State outlast Oregon State 46-41 on Saturday night and wrap up the host spot in the Pac-12 championship game Dec. 4.
